motion.name: Data hover
motion.purpose: Button feedback; disabled with reduced motion.

components.name: Data button
components.css: .ds-button { font: 14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; min-height:40px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid #343043; border-radius:7px; color:#d9d3e8; background:#11101e; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s,border-color .15s; } .ds-button:hover { color:#fff; border-color:#a78bfa; background:#20172e; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #bca0ff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.45; cursor:default; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition:none; } }

components.name: Data input
components.css: .ds-label { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:7px; color:#bcb5cc; font:500 12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height:42px; padding:8px 10px; border:1px solid #343043; border-radius:6px; color:#f0f0ff; background:#11101e; font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; caret-color:#c2a6ff; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#9b94aa; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #bca0ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Data views
components.css: .ds-views { display:flex; gap:6px; } .ds-views button { font:13px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; min-height:40px; padding:8px 14px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:7px; background:transparent; color:#b9b0ce; cursor:pointer; } .ds-views button[aria-pressed=true] { background:#302047; border-color:#74539c; color:#f0e8ff; } .ds-views button:hover { background:#20172e; border-color:#a78bfa; color:white; } .ds-views button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #bca0ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: EH card
components.css: .ds-card { padding:16px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07); border-radius:16px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.03); color:#f0f0ff; font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Dark surfaces, lavender accents, compact controls, and readable attendance records define the incumbent interface. Data extends the existing Chat and EH Challenge identity with denser tables and restrained section dividers.
keyCharacteristics: Dark purple surfaces; violet-to-blue accents in the app shell.
System typography, explicit labels, and concrete F3 terms.

rules.name: The Pinned Name Rule
rules.body: Keep wide tables horizontally scrollable and the first column sticky. On phones, its width is 145px and long names wrap; preserve the numeric columns rather than squeezing them into cards.

dos: Do preserve the existing dark purple identity across Chat, EH Challenge, and Data.
Do keep pinned names, native controls, visible focus, and attendance labels usable on phones.
donts: Don't replace semantic calendar labels with color alone or turn static dates into implied buttons.
